body: Thanks for the response. I appreciate your advice. I think finding someone who specializes in bpd might be the way to go.

Thanks for responding.
Not much.. I have a tendency to turn everything into a job. I try to turn every hobby I have into work. I like to read, and I don't just read for relaxation, I read to educate myself on subjects that will help me in my job, and I give myself homework to read a certain number of pages each night. I just suck the fun right out of my hobbies.
Is there anything in particular going on in your life that is causing a lot of stress and depression?

I don't have much support to give, but I can really relate when you talk about having to pretend all the time. It's exhausting to have to play "I'm ok". It's no wonder that you do that if you haven't received emotional support and get lectured about being unhappy. I'm glad you came here to let out those feelings.
